title: Guided Zero-Shot Anomaly Explanation for Anonymized Crowd Video Monitoring: Context, Categorization, and Spatial Localization
abstract: arXiv:2610.32073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the promising development of deep learning for video anomaly detection (VAD), explainability (XAI) of these models remains a challenge. Explainable and privacy-protecting VAD builds transparency and trust that facilitates adoption of computer vision systems, including safety and security monitoring. However, anomaly explainability in privacy-preserving VAD systems is underexplored. In this study, we present the XAVAD approach, a unified descriptive anomaly XAI for an anonymized VAD, that integrates flexible zero-shot anonymization, anomaly type categorization, visual localization, and scene context description. We provide empirical and qualitative assessments of multifaceted explanations integrated with full-body visual anonymization for privacy protection. translated_abstract: 尽管深度学习在视频异常检测（VAD）方面取得了令人瞩目的发展，但这些模型的可解释性（XAI）仍然是一个挑战。可解释且保护隐私的VAD能够建立透明度与信任，从而促进计算机视觉系统（包括安全与安防监控）的实际应用。然而，隐私保护型VAD系统中的异常可解释性仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们提出了XAVAD方法，这是一种针对匿名化VAD的统一描述性异常可解释AI框架，它集成了灵活的零样本匿名化、异常类型分类、视觉定位和场景上下文描述。我们对结合全身视觉匿名化以保护隐私的多方面解释进行了实证与定性评估。我们采用面向视频的多模态CLIP嵌入，使用改进的LLM辅助提示和池化评分机制进行异常类型识别，并增强了Grad-ECLIP...
tldr: 本文提出XAVAD方法，将零样本匿名化、异常类型分类、视觉定位与场景上下文描述统一整合，为匿名化视频异常检测提供可解释且保护隐私的多方面异常解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes XAVAD, a unified descriptive anomaly XAI framework that integrates zero-shot anonymization, anomaly type categorization, visual localization, and scene context description to deliver explainable and privacy-preserving anomaly explanations for anonymized video anomaly detection.
